Launch into clearance hold. Move across the surface, use yaw to set your heading, and hold Boost while moving forward. Release movement to brake automatically. Select a navigation target, follow its marker, then hold below 2 m/s within 30 m to scan.

DISPLAY

SCENE & SCALE

The supplied vehicle is retained at the original viewer’s assumed 9.6 m length. Terrain spans 1.6 km; the flight area is bounded to ±710 m. All distances are scene metres. Ground clearance follows the rendered terrain.

Procedural crater rims and dune-like regolith ridges are artistic lunar terrain, not a mapped location. The Moon has no wind-driven dunes. Dust uses ballistic gravity and no atmospheric fog or depth blur.

CONCEPT MODEL

Lift, reaction-control jets, reverse thrust and boost are simulated visual capabilities, not verified hardware. The source has no engine articulation clips. Vacuum propulsion is represented as reaction thrust; air-breathing ducted fans cannot provide lunar lift. Flight limits (22 m/s cruise, 45 m/s boost, 100 m target clearance) are interaction settings.

Optional sound represents onboard vibration and console feedback, not sound propagating through lunar vacuum. Terrain contact and clearance are approximations; decorative rocks have no collision bodies.
